source_admission: Published values used as constants, quoted ranges or cited findings; no external dataset files are admitted. 'access' records how far each source was checked in this study: 'abstract' or 'full text' when read here; 'search summary' when the finding was confirmed through a literature search's reading of the paper and not re-read here; 'agent report' when a literature-gathering agent read the source and quoted it. Model products of this repository are cited by path in the README.
